TAG WITHHELD, HOLDING THE LINE SET AT 17:30 ON 15 NOV. This run is a routine patched-and-updated message: the holds are unchanged, no new section 5 case opened, and nothing was blocked by them - the days-since patch and the stamp both committed cleanly. The scheduled task prompt says plainly not to tag routine updated messages, and section 4a warns that a mention on every heartbeat trains the reader to ignore it. At 00:30 on a Monday a mention on an unchanged six-day-old question is the least likely to be read as urgent and the most likely to train the tag away. So this run sent the updated shape, untagged, with all seven holds named, their age stated and the consolidated A/B question still in the message. Nothing about the holds is decided either way. It remains Arushi's call: if she would rather have the tag back every hour, the next run should resume it.
